subject: general
question: Pandit Birju Maharaj was honoured with the Padma Vibhushan in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is** __1986.__**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Birju Maharaj** was an Indian dancer, composer, and singer.
 
• Pandit Birju Maharaj was honoured with the Padma Vibhushan in **1986.**
 
• He was a descendant of the Maharaj** family of Kathak dancers.**
 
• Pandit Birju Maharaj is the face of the** Kalka-Bindadin Gharana of Lucknow.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Padma Vibhushan is the** second-highest civilian award of the Republic of India.**
 
• The award is given for **"exceptional and distinguished service".**
 
• Padma Awards 2022:** Yoga Guru Swami Sivananda, Ghulam Nabi Azad among winners.**
